semantic.justification: Task0V5WR6 connects the production Calc route to actual ScDocument,ScViewData and ScDocShell owners through shared SfxObjectShell,SfxUndoManager,SfxInterface,SfxViewFrame,dispatcher and command bindings. Controlled React presenters reuse Writer toolbar styles,Tailwind,Lucide and global fonts. The supported slice includes plain scalar/native local-A1 input,recalculation,cancel,selection,name-box navigation,sheet append/switch,typed token-valued undo/redo and bounded browser viewport projection. Compiled formula adoption retains code errors in history;sheet deletion ends formula subscriptions and renumbers source cells. One real model owns cells;browser state contains transient input/geometry only. This is a bounded editable workspace,not full Calc/native parity. TaskGBSSRW implements native ScTokenArray deep Clone with independent code tokens and first matching cloned code identity reused by RPN;RPN-only tokens clone separately,retaining represented flags and leaving native finalized default false. Same-document same-position ScFormulaCell copy/Clone retains cached result,dirty state and grammar,deep-copies code and follows native nonempty-error reset/recompile rule without starting listeners. Unsupported relocation/foreign-document/name/external/group/reference-adjustment services remain explicit. Represented destructor tracking/listener cleanup uses existing Dispose. Native ScCellValue now owns empty/numeric/shared-string/formula values,copies real borrowed/document content and commits cloned formulas;current plain literal text setter maps source SetString/setTextInput semantics without format services. Browser Undo owns actual ScCellValue before/after and releases through existing SfxUndoAction Dispose;the browser stored-cell union and token snapshot reconstruction are removed. Full EditEngine/rich text,clone relocation,clipboard/undo document modes,format services and whole Calc parity remain unported.
